 This Criminal Petition Is Filed Under Section 482 Of
The Code Of Criminal Procedure, Praying To Quash The
Proceedings Pending In C.C.No.721/2021 On The File Of The
Hon'Ble Principal Civil Judge And Jmfc, Maddur For
Offences Punishable Under Sections 498-A, 506 R/W
Section 34 Of Ipc And U/S. 3 And 4 Of Dowry Prohibition
Act, Which Is Arising Out Of Crime No.128/2019 Of
K.M.Doddi Police, Mandya District As An Abuse Of Process
Of Law.

This Petition, Coming On For Reporting Settlement,
This Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order
Petitioners-accused No.1 to 3 are sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506, r/w 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. The case of the prosecution is that, the accused No.1 husband, accused No.2 mother-in-law,
accused No.3 father-in-law subjected the defacto-complainant to cruelty, both, mentally and physically, and also a demand was made to bring money from the parental home.
3.
The parties are present before this Court and they have filed an application under Section 320 r/w 482 of Cr.P.C. for compounding of the offences.
Mr. Punith Kumar.

S vs State Of Karnataka By on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36080072/
2 NC: 2023:KHC:33785 4.
The same is placed on record.
5. Perusal of the application indicates that the parties have amicably resolved their dispute among themselves.
The defacto-complainant has reunited with her husband and leading a cordial marital life, and she has no objections for quashing the impugned proceedings.

6. Though the offences alleged against the petitioners- accused herein are cognizable and non-compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves, it would be futile exercise, if the petitioners-accused herein are subjected to trial, since the probability of their conviction is remote and bleak, in view of the settlement.
Therefore, the continuation of the criminal proceedings will be an abuse of process of law.

7. Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The Criminal Petition is allowed;
ii) The impugned proceedings in C.C. No.721/2021 on the file of the Principal Civil Judge and JMFC, Maddur, arising out of Crime No.128/2019, registered by the K.M.Doddi Police Station, is hereby quashed.
Sd/-
JUDGE HR Mr. Punith Kumar.
